auditor: gpt-5.6-sol blind (fresh codex exec, read-only scratch workdir, r6)

probe_detail.name: Withholds exactly the detail the headline makes the reader want
Signals direct consequence for the reader's own life

final.name: Leading geographic dateline
final.audit_justification: Beginning with a place is chiefly a bureau or desk convention, though bureau-produced reporting may also benefit from genuine local expertise.

final.name: Practical service promise
final.audit_justification: A promise of actionable help communicates substantive utility that can directly motivate readers to open the story.

final.name: Mystery-death hook
final.audit_justification: Making an unresolved cause central creates a substantive mystery and information need rather than merely marking a surface convention.

final.name: Ideological Polarization
final.audit_justification: Explicit conflict between meaningful social or ideological positions is substantive information about the story's stakes.

final.name: Location-heavy wording
final.audit_justification: Counting geographic names primarily identifies foreign or location-oriented subject matter rather than a generally meaningful appeal property.

final.name: Celebrity personal-name slot
final.audit_justification: A celebrity-name-and-colon opening combines a topic marker with desk and placement conventions.

final.name: Social-Identity Resonance
final.audit_justification: Invoking belonging or a shared identity is substantive audience relevance that can genuinely shape reading interest.

final.name: Domestic-UK angle tell
final.audit_justification: UK references chiefly mark domestic subject matter and a larger home-audience baseline.
final.upstream_parent: national desk promotion to domestic audience

final.name: Quoted speech
final.audit_justification: The presence of quotation marks alone is a punctuation and format fingerprint rather than evidence about substantive appeal.

final.name: Concrete Scene Vividness
final.audit_justification: Concrete, readily imagined scenes communicate the event more vividly and can substantively engage readers.

final.name: In-quote ordinary voice
final.audit_justification: This construction principally identifies a feature-commission format, although such commissions may also contain genuinely compelling personal reporting.

final.name: Numerical specificity
final.audit_justification: The mere presence of numbers can fingerprint data-led or breaking-news treatments, though those practices may also supply genuinely useful precision.

final.name: First-person voice
final.audit_justification: First-person wording primarily marks a testimonial or feature format, although that upstream reporting approach can also provide substantive human perspective.
final.arbiter_reason: First-person language chiefly identifies a testimonial or feature format rather than measuring reader interest itself. The reporting approach behind it can also provide genuine human perspective.

final.name: Source Transparency
final.audit_justification: Identifying evidence or attribution substantively clarifies the provenance and credibility of a claim.

final.name: Follow-up headline ellipticalness
final.audit_justification: Reliance on prior knowledge is mainly a temporal running-story fingerprint, though major stories that receive follow-ups may also retain genuine reader interest.

final.name: Running-story recap framing
final.audit_justification: Stock recap wording fingerprints a later story position or explainer slot, although a real explainer can also offer substantive understanding.

final.name: Explicit question-mark headline
final.audit_justification: Ending with a question mark is purely a punctuation convention without establishing the question's substantive value.
final.upstream_parent: Explainer/live-blog desk writes follow-up items on day 2+ of running stories

final.name: Explicit emotion word
final.audit_justification: When emotion is genuinely the story, naming it communicates substantive human stakes and affective relevance.

final.name: Explanation or analysis marker
final.audit_justification: Formulaic explainer labels chiefly mark an editorial format, although the associated analysis may also deliver genuinely useful understanding.
final.arbiter_reason: Explainer labels are editorial-format markers rather than substantive evidence of what readers actually choose to read. The underlying analytical work can nevertheless produce genuine understanding.

final.name: Curiosity gap
final.audit_justification: Withholding a salient answer creates a substantive information gap that can directly motivate a click.

final.name: Personal welfare stakes
final.audit_justification: Concrete effects on individual health, safety, rights, or routines are substantive personal stakes.

final.name: Scare-quoted scepticism marker
final.audit_justification: Scare quotes are chiefly a punctuation and hedging convention, though an upstream practice of qualified attribution can sometimes improve accuracy.
final.arbiter_reason: Scare quotes measure a punctuation and hedging convention, not substantive evidence about readership. Their upstream cause may include careful qualification that improves accuracy.

final.name: POLARIZATION
final.audit_justification: An explicitly divisive proposition or conflict between camps is substantive information about the story's social stakes.

final.name: Mundane-relatable action
final.audit_justification: The contrast between an ordinary relatable action and a remarkable outcome is a substantive human-interest hook.

final.name: Reader-addressing question
final.audit_justification: Question-to-reader phrasing is largely a rhetorical template, although it may originate in genuinely informative service or explainer journalism.
final.arbiter_reason: Reader-addressing questions are rhetorical templates rather than direct evidence about actual clicking behavior. They may also arise from genuinely useful service or explainer journalism.
